content: Xenni igeɛɛed Musa zi řewḍat n Mu’ab ɣar wedrar n Nabu, ɣar tqiccet n Fisja nni iwejjhen Ariḥa uca isscen as SIDI marra tammurt, zi Jilɛad ař Dan,
marra Naftali d temmurt n Ifrayim d Manassa d marra tammurt n Yahuda ař řebḥar d min din awarni as,
d Temmurt n Ljanub d udewwar n řewḍa n Ariḥa, Tandint n Tcejjura n Tini ař Ṣuɣar.
Uca inna as SIDI: “Ta d tammurt nni x jjuǧeɣ i Ibrahim, d Isḥaq d Yaɛqub, nniɣ: ‘I zzariɛet nnec, ad tt wceɣ!” Jjiɣ cek ad tt tẓared s tiṭṭawin nnec, maca war tẓekkʷid ca diha.”
Ammu i dinni immut Musa, amsexxar n SIDI, di temmurt n Mu’ab, am mammec awař i dd-iffɣen zeg uqemmum n SIDI.
Uca Netta inḍeř i-t di teɣzurt di temmurt n Mu’ab qibač i Bayt-Faɣur uca uřa d ijj issen amcan n wenḍeř nnes ař ass-a.
Tuɣa Musa ɣares mya u-ɛicrin n iseggʷusa umi immut. Tiṭṭ nnes war teɣri ca, war d as iruḥ řemɛezz.
Sɣuyyen ayt n Israil x Musa di řewḍat n Mu’ab třatin n wussan uca ammu i ttwakemmřen ussan n iɣuyyan d wecḍan n Musa.
Yacuwa, mmis n Nun, tuɣa iccur s buḥbeř n tiɣit, minzi Musa tuɣa issars xas ifassen nnes u ayt n Israil sřin ɣares uca ggin am mammec t yumur SIDI i Musa.
Ɛemmarṣ ɛad war dd-ikkar anabi di Israil am Musa, wenni tuɣa issnen SIDI udem ɣar wudem,
s marra řeɛřamat nni zi t issekk SIDI, ḥima ad tent igg di temmurt n Miṣra, zzat i firɛun d marra imsexxaren nnes d marra tammurt nnes,
u s marra afus nni ijehden u s marra timegga imɣaren issaggʷaden, tinni igga Musa zzat i tiṭṭawin n marra Israil.
